Description

Narrower roll format of our popular anti-slip rubber mat range. At 125mm wide, this roll is ideal where less coverage width is needed — between pallet layers, on container floors or between stacked goods.

Same durable recycled rubber quality as our 250mm range. High friction coefficient of >0.6μ prevents cargo movement during transport. 100% reusable — simply roll up and store after use.

In stock and ready to ship. EU delivery within 2–4 business days. Worldwide freight available on request — contact us at info@sorbpack.com for a quote.
